# framezero

> Make vertical (9:16) app promo videos for TikTok/Reels/Shorts from deterministic HTML scenes. Playwright screenshots each frame, ffmpeg encodes 1080p or 4K60, and numpy synthesizes copyright-free lo-fi music and sound effects synced to the same timeline. Plain HTML/JS/Python with no bundler, React or GPU. Built for humans and AI coding agents.

## Start here
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): step-by-step operating manual for AI agents (inputs, script table, hard rules, QA loop, sound map, render commands, pitfalls)
- [README.md](README.md): overview, quickstart, showcase
- [skills/framezero/SKILL.md](skills/framezero/SKILL.md): the same workflow as an Agent Skill

## Engine
- [kit/render.py](kit/render.py): HTML scene → MP4 or stills (`--stills`, `--scale 2`, `--fps 60`, `--audio`, `--frames-dir`)
- [kit/assemble.sh](kit/assemble.sh): chunked 4K encode that fits in about 1 GB RAM
- [kit/motion.js](kit/motion.js): deterministic animation helpers (prog, lerp, E easings, pose, slam, rise, pulse, shake, wipes, letters, makeCamera)
- [kit/sound.py](kit/sound.py): synth + effects + mixing (lofi_keys, lofi_beat, vinyl, whoosh, impact, pop, click, ding, coin, riser, Mix)

## Templates & examples
- [templates/starter.html](templates/starter.html): complete 12.6 s English promo (hook → 3 features with phone camera → CTA → loop)
- [templates/soundtrack.py](templates/soundtrack.py): its synced soundtrack
- [examples/estuda-tour/](examples/estuda-tour/): a real 39 s app-tour video with screenshots (Portuguese on-screen text)
